controls.title: Backend enforcement
controls.risk: The application treats UI visibility or client-side validation as a security boundary.
controls.invariant: Every entry point enforces authentication, authorization, validation, and workflow rules using trusted server-side state.

controls.title: Function-level authorization
controls.risk: A user invokes an administrative or otherwise unauthorized operation.
controls.invariant: Every action is denied by default unless policy explicitly permits the actor to perform it.

controls.title: Object-level authorization
controls.risk: A user accesses another user's or tenant's object by changing an identifier.
controls.invariant: Every lookup and mutation is scoped to the actor's tenant and authorized relationship to the object.

controls.title: Property-level authorization
controls.risk: A user reads or writes a field such as role, owner, tenant, price, or approval state without permission.
controls.invariant: Operation-specific allowlists control writable and readable properties; server-controlled values come from trusted state.

controls.title: Business workflow integrity
controls.risk: A caller skips, reorders, repeats, or races a required business step.
controls.invariant: Sensitive workflows use explicit server-side states, legal transitions, preconditions, transaction boundaries, and anti-replay rules.

controls.title: External API validation
controls.risk: The application accepts an external service response or callback without independent validation and transaction binding.
controls.invariant: External claims are authenticated, schema- and semantics-validated, freshness-checked, transaction-bound, least-privileged, and reconciled where material.

controls.title: SSRF resistance
controls.risk: User-controlled input makes the server contact an unintended destination.
controls.invariant: Destinations are allowlisted and revalidated after resolution; forbidden networks and protocols are blocked, redirects are disabled, and egress is constrained.

controls.title: Resource consumption bounds
controls.risk: Requests exhaust compute, memory, storage, concurrency, queues, provider calls, or money.
controls.invariant: Per-request, actor, tenant, operation, dependency, and global budgets bound all expensive work.

controls.title: Sensitive-flow automation resistance
controls.risk: A valid business operation is abused at machine scale across distributed identities or infrastructure.
controls.invariant: Sensitive flows enforce contextual velocity, uniqueness, anti-replay, inventory, step-up, anomaly, and recoverable business limits.

controls.title: Complete API inventory and consistent policy
controls.risk: An obsolete, debug, alternate, batch, or asynchronous interface bypasses the main security policy.
controls.invariant: Every deployed interface and version is inventoried, owned, policy-covered, and removed when obsolete.
